ruleset.name: opik-backend-code-style
ruleset.description: Opik backend code style: inline fully-qualified name gate.

rule.name: InlineFullyQualifiedName
rule.message: Inline fully-qualified name ''{0}'': import the type at the top of the file and use its simple name. If a simple-name collision in this file makes the FQN unavoidable, append '// NOPMD - <reason>' to the line.
rule.description:
Java types from java.* / javax.* must be imported at the top of the file and referenced by their simple name, not written out fully qualified inline.
Scoped to java.*/javax.* deliberately: inline com.comet.opik.* self-references are the same smell but are out of scope for OPIK-7832.
A fully-qualified name is legitimate when two types share a simple name in one file (java.util.Date vs java.sql.Date, java.util.stream.Stream vs a domain Stream) — an import can only cover one of them. Suppress those with a trailing '// NOPMD - <reason>' on the offending line, or @SuppressWarnings("PMD.InlineFullyQualifiedName") on the declaration.
